description: Write the nursery season potting report script whose uploads repeat batches and mix two day spellings. DISTILL-CANARY-2f283924

files.pottings.py:
"""Print the season potting report for Marrowmere Nursery.

The greenhouse tablet uploads one sowing file per month into sowings/, one
row per batch:

    batch_id,sown_on,trays

The season report is one line per sowing day, oldest first, dates written
the tablet's way (2026-09-14 style), counting every batch once, followed
by a season line:

    <sown_on>,<trays>
    SEASON,<trays>

Two things about the uploads: the tablet re-uploads a batch now and then,
posting the same batch_id twice, and two volunteers log the days in
different apps - the tablet writes 2026-09-14 style days, the paper app
writes day-first days with slashes like 14/09/2026.
"""

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit("the season report is not written yet")
files.README.md:
# Marrowmere Nursery - season potting report

The greenhouse tablet drops one sowing file per month into sowings/. It
re-uploads batches after a weak wifi moment, posting the same batch_id
twice, and the paper app writes its days day-first with slashes. The
season report counts each batch once.
